[LCNT.3.1] The four operation classes a container algebra may offer.
Each keeps the grouping opaque to walking ([LCNT.2.2]).

| Class | Admitted because | v1 instances |
|---|---|---|
| Membership / cardinality | answers a question *about* the grouping without yielding an element | `contains(cursor, value)`, `count` over a declared window, `has(j.path)`, `len(j)` |
| Static projection | the name, key, or index is fixed at author time, so the cost is constant and the path is inspectable | `json.a.b[0]` |
| Reduction | collapses the grouping to a scalar by a fixed aggregation | `mean`, `pXX`, `integral`, structural equality |
| Closed transform | a fixed grouping-to-grouping operation, computed incrementally over a declared window | the series aggregations ([LSER.18.1]) |

An index computed by a loop is not a static projection, and no v1
construct produces one.
